cgroup_v2.title: cgroup v2 only (no cgroup v1 hierarchy mounted for the distro)
cgroup_v2.description: Runtimes before 2.5.1 mount a hybrid cgroup v1 hierarchy. A distro whose systemd is cgroup v2 only (systemd 258+) cannot start as PID 1 on them and never boots. 2.5.1 (pre-release) removed cgroup v1; 2.5.7 is the first stable runtime with that change. 2.6.2 added the wsl.conf opt-in automount.cgroups=v1.

distros.symptom: Catastrophic failure / Error code: Wsl/Service/E_UNEXPECTED on every launch
distros.cause: Ubuntu 26.04 is cgroup v2 only (systemd 259; cgroup v1 legacy and hybrid hierarchies removed). Observed: given a cgroup v1 hierarchy the distro PID 1 exits at init and the launch fails with E_UNEXPECTED, and the same disk boots with systemd off (docs/research/2026-09-cgroup-v1-observed.md).
